name: Felix Hall
contribution: A browser demo that uploads CSVs and runs Edison scientific analysis with live notebook streaming.
headline: Ask questions of your CSV data
summary: Too often AI analysis is vague and can feel like a black box. This is a standalone FastAPI app: upload CSVs (or use bundled sample data), ask a research question, and watch our analysis stream back live notebook cells and downloadable artifacts.
body:
Built a self-contained Edison Data Analysis demo — no auth layer, just a clean browser UI (leveraging the Edison client SDK).

Upload your own CSVs or click through bundled sample HR data, pose a research question, and the app polls Edison while rendering results in real time. Typical runs take 2–5 minutes; artifacts are downloadable when complete.

Stack: Python 3.11+, FastAPI, SSE streaming, Edison client SDK. Deploy target is Lomond Garden — link coming once the site is live.
